probes.name: calculate_enabled
probes.sink:
Public WithEvents Sheet As Worksheet
Public WithEvents Book As Workbook
Public WithEvents App As Application
Private Sub Sheet_Calculate()
If Not Armed Then Exit Sub
Log = Log & "sheet-sink;"
If Phase = "sheet-sink" Then Application.EnableEvents = False
End Sub
Private Sub Book_SheetCalculate(ByVal Sh As Object)
If Not Armed Then Exit Sub
Log = Log & "book-sink;"
If Phase = "book-sink" Then Application.EnableEvents = False
End Sub
Private Sub App_SheetCalculate(ByVal Sh As Object)
If Not Armed Then Exit Sub
Log = Log & "app-sink;"
If Phase = "app-sink" Then Application.EnableEvents = False
End Sub
probes.sheet_handler:
Private Sub Worksheet_Calculate()
If Not Armed Then Exit Sub
Log = Log & "sheet-own;"
If Phase = "sheet-own" Then Application.EnableEvents = False
End Sub
probes.book_handler:
Private Sub Workbook_SheetCalculate(ByVal Sh As Object)
If Not Armed Then Exit Sub
Log = Log & "book-own;"
If Phase = "book-own" Then Application.EnableEvents = False
End Sub
probes.source:
Function Probe() As String
Application.EnableEvents = False
Application.Calculation = -4135
Range("A1").Value2 = 1
Range("B1").Formula = "=A1*2"
Dim listener As New ExcelSink
Set listener.Sheet = ActiveSheet
Set listener.Book = ActiveWorkbook
Set listener.App = Application
Application.Calculate
Application.EnableEvents = True
Application.Calculate
Range("A1").Value2 = 3
Log = ""
Phase = ""
Armed = True
Application.Calculate
Probe = Log & CStr(Application.EnableEvents)
Application.EnableEvents = False
End Function
